{{Top|leg}}
{{Youmay|the rank within the [[Black Bha'lir]]|the [[Old Guard|group]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] considered to be candidates for the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]}}
'''Old Guard''' was the most respected rank within the [[Black Bha'lir]]. It was awarded to those members who had achieved the rank of [[Mentor (Black Bha'lir)|Mentor]] and still continued to work in the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] world. Members of the Old Guard were generally in some form of retirement but continued to support the Black Bha'lir in some form, such as a [[Master Smuggler]]. Only three percent of the Black Bha'lir's membership achieved the rank of Old Guard, and only members of the Old Guard were considered for election to the [[Tribunal of the Black Bha'lir Society]].<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
